release_notes: Build 113 stops the Autopilot Needs You status from flashing between Needs you and Working while background supervision runs.
Outstanding human tasks now keep Needs you as the stable status until those tasks are actually cleared.
The one-second Needs You synchronizer no longer rewrites identical text values, reducing unnecessary WPF layout and repaint work.
Needs You task cards are still rebuilt only when their aligned task summary changes, and the guided Start next task control is restored after a genuine card refresh.
Regression tests cover the stable Needs you state even while Autopilot background work is active.
Build 112 performance-driven quiz category selection remains included unchanged.
